title: Junior docs stage protest at Kolkata Medical College, demand withdrawal of show-cause notices

ai.summary: Junior doctors at Kolkata Medical College staged protests demanding withdrawal of show-cause notices for eight interns, who criticized shifting critically injured stampede victims to private hospitals instead of government facilities.

facts.claim: Junior doctors staged demonstrations at Kolkata Medical College
facts.quote: Junior docs stage protest at Kolkata Medical College, demand withdrawal of show-cause notices

facts.claim: Eight interns received show-cause notices for criticizing government's decision to shift stampede victims to private hospitals
facts.quote: The eight junior doctors were served show-cause notices on Tuesday for criticising the government's decision to shift people injured in the stampede at the Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal to a private hospital.

facts.claim: At least 19 people died in the stampede at Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal on October 17
facts.quote: At least 19 people died, and 25 others were injured in the stampede at the Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal in north Kolkata on October 17, following a crowd surge amid rain.

facts.claim: Doctors questioned why critically injured patients were moved to private hospitals when government facilities could provide free care
facts.quote: The junior doctors, in a press conference, had questioned why these critically injured patients requiring advanced, life-saving treatment had to be moved to a private hospital when government medical colleges were equipped to provide such care free of cost.

facts.claim: Protesters gheraoed the principal for several hours
facts.quote: Principal Indranil Biswas was also reportedly gheraoed by the protesters for several hours.

facts.claim: ABVP supporters allegedly entered campus amid demonstrations
facts.quote: The protesters also clashed with alleged ABVP supporters, who entered the campus amid the demonstrations, officials said.

facts.claim: Health Minister Shardwat Mukherjee said protests should not take the form of a gherao
facts.quote: Meanwhile, West Bengal Health Minister Shardwat Mukherjee said protests should not take the form of a gherao.

ai.background_note: Junior doctors protested over show-cause notices for interns who criticized shifting stampede victims to private hospitals, highlighting healthcare access issues after a fatal crowd incident.
